name: Mending Old Wounds

narrative.offerRewardText: I'm happy you're seeing the error of your ways, adventurer. Keep the supplies coming; we're not going to forget about you so easily, mister!
narrative.requestItemsText:
You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, adventurer! Word's been getting around of your dirty deeds.

You're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers. This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel. Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions.

objectiveItems.name: Empty Vial
